lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters are arranged in a multi-row horizontal alignment across the mid-flank; a specific group of five prominent spots forms a trapezoidal cluster posterior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of white spots, creating a discernible grid pattern across the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient (high-intensity upper edge, low-intensity lower edge) extending from the post-cranial region towards the caudal peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch is visible on the posterior trailing margin of the first dorsal fin, approximately midway between the apex and the base.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense aggregation of commensal fish is clustered around the pectoral fin and ventral surface; several elongated remora-like individuals are visible positioned horizontally along the lower flank.
